_description: Per-contract metadata for the NDA bucket. Captures deal context, customer type, negotiation posture, regulatory overlays and the distinguishing features that each NDA is meant to exemplify. Read alongside entity_maps.json and the per-contract tokenized templates in ../../tokenized/NDA/synthetic/.
